earlier_preview.finding: The carve-out “Artifact Revision other than an Atom” still treats Atom as a subtype of Artifact, contrary to accepted Artifact=file/folder and Object=model entity instance; its target is still the represented Structural Entity Revision, not the physical Directory Carrier. It is not a Carrier-only successor.

evidence: M454@5 defines Artifact as file or folder; R1958 defines Carrier as storage representation distinct from its represented Object, with Object any model Entity instance.
R2247@11 permits declared Carrier descriptors/instances as Relation endpoints; R2478 requires an IS_CONTAINED_BY target classified Container=yes and defines inverse CONTAINS.
R1956 defines Directory Carrier but does not itself declare Container=yes or establish the per-direction Carrier instance permissions needed for a formal containment edge.

Current D264 states a relation between the represented Artifact Revision and the Structural Entity Revision carried by its nearest directory, not necessarily between Carrier representations. Changing its endpoints is a substantive authority change, not a proven mechanical rewording.

D266@30 Draft preserves Atom logical containment from Header.Container and separately treats non-Atom carrier-derived containment; R1660 prohibits physical nesting from silently replacing logical parentage.
one_unresolved_choice: Should nearest-directory physical nesting be exposed only as a physical Carrier-location view, or should it also be a formal IS_CONTAINED_BY edge between the child Carrier and Directory Carrier instances, with explicit model admission/permissions for that edge?
if_resolved: Preserve the distinction between physical representation and represented Object; keep exactly-one nearest directory where applicable and derived inverse only if the selected view admits them. Preserve no-write/no new Version and Project Structure parentage safeguards. Any required Carrier permissions need their own existing authority or separately reviewed source, not an invented property.
preview: None: a whole-Atom successor would otherwise either discard the existing formal relation claim or assert unestablished Carrier endpoint permissions.
limits: No Current, actual Draft, carrier moves, code, tests, Workflow or Git mutation.
